topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this is happening. I just found out—someone, somehow, took my art and made it permanent on their skin. This isn't some small sketch, a throwaway idea. No, they went big, chose one of my most personal pieces. The one that took sleepless nights, where I poured every ounce of myself into the canvas. Now, it's out there, marked on someone else, beyond my control. I tried calling the studio; no one answers. My hands are shaking, and all I can think about is how that artwork, meant to stay on my wall, to be something I could take down or change or hide away, is now out in the world, irreversible. What if they don't understand it, what if they misconstrue everything it means? My art, my expression, now living on someone’s flesh, forever.
